name: Christian Relationships
overview: Christian relationships are founded on God’s design for unity and love, beginning with the marital bond where a man leaves his parents to become one flesh with his wife, as shown in Genesis 2:24. Honoring parents is also a vital aspect of these relationships, bringing blessing and longevity according to Exodus 20:12. Furthermore, believers are called to demonstrate sincere love, rejecting evil and embracing what is good, while exercising humility, patience, and forbearance toward one another in love, as emphasized in Romans 12:9 and Ephesians 4:2.
